verdict.rationale: Loops, an email SaaS platform, documents an official hosted remote MCP server at https://mcp.loops.so, with a one-line Claude setup command. Its scope is listed explicitly: contacts, mailing lists, transactional email, events, and the rest of the API. A probe confirms the dedicated MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as described.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect Claude or any remote MCP client to Loops. Your agent can manage contacts and mailing lists, send transactional email, and work with events.
claude mcp add --transport http --scope user loops https://mcp.loops.so
Connect your agent to Loops over MCP. Read and write contacts, events, and content from any client.
Manage contacts and mailing lists, send transactional emails, work with events, and access the rest of the Loops API.
